integrity: Proof and finite exact checks are supplied. Priority is best-knowledge rather than certified; independent scientific audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact for two distinct central SU(2) characters at exponent four only; no multi-mode or noncentral extension. Even-separation norm is uniquely characterized by a positive polynomial root. Historical Chebyshev norm literature may contain an equivalent formula.
title: Sharp fourth moments for every two-character central Fourier packet on \(SU(2)\)
